title: How headlights got brighter, whiter, and more blinding after dark
summary: Early automotive lamps were less like searchlights and more like dim lanterns politely suggesting that there may or may not be a vehicle present. From the driver’s perspective, these early headlights did little more than marginally improve visibility.
